headline: Heat Pumps in Rhode Island: Surviving a New England Winter, Sizing It Right and Mistakes to Avoid
subheading: AJ from Vortechs HVAC in Wakefield explains when a heat pump can heat a Rhode Island home on its own, how to keep the outdoor unit above snow and ice, why a Manual J load calculation matters, and the three mistakes he warns every homeowner about.
seoTitle: Rhode Island Heat Pumps: New England Winter Advice
description: A South County, RI installer on heat pumps in New England winters: sizing, snow and ice mounting, older homes, oil vs gas costs, and mistakes to avoid.
